scope_notes: Local durable endpoint transfers with serialized HTTP-body-equivalent bytes; no WAN, TLS, packet, or physical-link timing claim.
Operation CPU already includes sender+receiver in one process. Receiver/exchange are nested; never add them to operation totals.
Exchange wall includes serialization, handler, durability and waiting; not pure byte send time.
Verification/reopen CPU+wall separate from durable commit operation; both retained.
Median averages middle two observations; nearest-rank p95 for10 trials is observed maximum.
Deterministic rotating method order, not independent randomized network trials.
Conventional adaptive arm uses the small checkpoint as base; no previous full-trace cache baseline was measured.
Verifier checks complete raw receipts and pinned code. It does not repeat byte comparisons against caches that the measured harness already removed.
Favorable generated/edited traces are deliberately model-derived; unrelated controls and unsuccessful candidate compute retained.
